channel.title: The Awesome Ledger — awesome-selfhosted
channel.description: New entries across the GitHub awesome ecosystem, diffed nightly.

item.title: Relaticle — via awesome-selfhosted
item.description: CRM with a production-grade MCP server (32 tools) for AI agents, human-in-the-loop approvals, REST API, custom fields, and kanban boards. (Source Code) AGPL-3.0 PHP/Docker

item.title: NutriTrace — via awesome-selfhosted
item.description: Nutrition and diet tracker with barcode scanning, wearable integrations (Fitbit, Withings, Garmin, Health Connect), adaptive calorie goals, multi-user sharing, and a built-in AI assistant (alternative to MyFitnessPal, Cronometer). (Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Docker

item.title: Nona — via awesome-selfhosted
item.description: Remote configuration and feature flag service with a single REST API, multiple environments, and official JavaScript and .NET clients (alternative to Firebase Remote Config). (Source Code) Apache-2.0 Docker

item.title: Expensave — via awesome-selfhosted
item.description: Expense tracker for personal and family budget management. Track spending on a shared calendar, import bank statements and monitor finances with reports. GPL-3.0 Docker

item.title: Compass — via awesome-selfhosted
item.description: Landing page for services, dashboards, and documents, with automatic discovery from sources such as Docker, Kubernetes, and Tailscale. (Source Code) Apache-2.0 Go/Docker/K8S

item.title: OpenReader — via awesome-selfhosted
item.description: EPUB, PDF, DOCX, MD, and TXT file text to speech document reader. Read documents in realtime with high-quality TTS; or extract audiobooks. (Source Code) MIT Docker

item.title: Houndarr — via awesome-selfhosted
item.description: Scheduled backlog searches for Radarr, Sonarr, Lidarr, Readarr and Whisparr. Works through missing and cutoff-unmet items in small rate-limited batches with per-item cooldowns and hourly caps, to avoid overloading indexers. (Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Python/Docker

item.title: Plainpad — via awesome-selfhosted
item.description: Modern note taking application for the cloud, utilizing the best features of progressive web apps technology. (Demo, Source Code) GPL-3.0 PHP

item.title: Elengrab — via awesome-selfhosted
item.description: Fast cross-platform video and audio downloader and media viewer with flexible format and quality options. Supports 1000+ websites including YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, Twitch and more. (Demo) AGPL-3.0 Go/Docker

item.title: memEx — via awesome-selfhosted
item.description: Structured personal knowledge base, inspired by zettlekasten and org-mode. AGPL-3.0 Docker

item.title: musikcube — via awesome-selfhosted
item.description: Streaming audio server with Linux/macOS/Windows/Android clients. BSD-3-Clause C++/deb

item.title: SnappyMail — via awesome-selfhosted
item.description: Simple, modern, lightweight & fast web-based email client (fork of RainLoop). AGPL-3.0 PHP

item.title: Ratelog — via awesome-selfhosted
item.description: Movie tracker and rating app (alternative to Letterboxd). (Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Docker

item.title: GeneWeb — via awesome-selfhosted
item.description: Genealogy software that can be used offline or as a Web service. (Source Code) GPL-2.0 OCaml

item.title: Bluecherry — via awesome-selfhosted
item.description: Closed-circuit television (CCTV) software application which supports IP and Analog cameras. GPL-2.0 PHP
